cyan-signal.$description: Cyan Signal — Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Page canvas, section backgrounds, soft card surfaces — the warm off-white ground everything sits on

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Inset cards, modal surfaces, inverse button text, nav background

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Subtle accent surfaces, inset focus rings, warm shadow tints

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mid-ink.$description: Mid Ink — Button text and border on dark surfaces, icon stroke

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Headline text alternative, deep emphasis borders

pewter.$description: Pewter — Secondary body text, muted helper text, inactive state text

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — SVG illustration linework, deepest icon fills

midnight-violet.$description: Midnight Violet — Illustration primary — the dominant dark shape color in cubist murals

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Illustration mid-tone — secondary dark purple in mural compositions

coral-burst.$description: Coral Burst — Illustration warm accent — orange-red shape fills in murals

aqua-glow.$description: Aqua Glow — Illustration cool accent and icon highlight — teal punctuation in murals

vivid-amethyst.$description: Vivid Amethyst — Illustration bright accent — saturated purple shape fills

blush.$description: Blush — Illustration soft accent — pink shape fills for warmth in murals

dropmarkrealhead.$description: Display and section headings only — used at 60px for hero, 40px for section titles, 24px for sub-section headings. Medium weight is deliberate; avoids the heavy 700 convention to keep headlines calm and editorial rather than assertive.

dropmarkrealtext.$description: Body, buttons, nav, list, footer, supporting UI. 400 for body and links, 600 for emphasized sub-labels and button text, 700 reserved for occasional inline emphasis. Functions as the working sans — every non-heading element uses it.
